title: 3x+1 inverse orbit generating functions almost always have natural boundaries
notes: Read 23 September 2026: signed shortcut maps and Theorems 1.1-1.3 in the full text. Theorem 1.2 gives a natural boundary for every positive plus target except possibly 1,2,4,8; Theorem 1.3 gives it for every positive minus target. Analytic noncontinuability supplies no lower bound on harmonic ancestor mass. In both signs target 3 has ancestor set {3*2^k:k>=0}, reciprocal mass 2/3, and the natural boundary guaranteed by these theorems. The root is divisible by three, so this does not refute a lower bound restricted to unit roots. See docs/problems/collatz_ancestor_generating_audit.md. No claim to have formalized the complex-analytic theorems.
